name: Brutal Blast
body:
Prerequisite(s): Any simple blast.

Benefit(s): Your form infusions use your Constitution modifier instead of your Dexterity to calculate saving throws.

Normal: You use your Dexterity modifier to calculate saving throws for your form infusions.
